product: OpenAI GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol are now available on Unity Gateway
tagline: OpenAI GPT 6.2 Astra and GPT 6.2 Sol are now available on Unity Gateway.
what_it_does: OpenAI GPT 6.2 Astra and GPT 6.2 Sol are now available on Unity Gateway. You can access these models using Foundation Model APIs. Both models support text and image inputs, function calling, reasoning, and priority pay per token.
why_it_matters: Customers are responsible for ensuring their compliance with applicable terms.
